record.title: Execute the frozen APK reader against a disposable ARM64 mapping fixture
record.intent: Validate actual positioned reads and repeated evidence with the new APK backing contract.
requirements: Use only an explicitly selected loopback disposable ARM64 guest and dedicated ADB server; no physical contact. Freeze run inputs before execution.
Record fixture backing hash and fresh PID/starttime/boot/maps. Run wrong-starttime, wrong-pin and unmapped-range controls before exactly one positive reader attempt.
Verify rejected controls read zero memory and positive attempt reads exactly48bytes matching declared synthetic fixture values, with stable metadata and independently resolved addresses.
Preserve failed results without modifying and rerunning the same experiment. Seal evidence, stop disposable processes and commit/push conclusion.
acceptance: A reproducible guest result or exact failure is retained for decision.
